# Jakob Riis

Jakob Riis serves as Datamanager at [[rkkp|RKKP]], the organization responsible for maintaining Denmark's national registry infrastructure. He is a member of the steering committee for [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), where he provides epidemiological and data management support.

Riis appears in the steering committee documentation across multiple reporting periods. He was listed as "Datamanager RKKP" in the 2023 DANIBD annual report [^src1] and as "Datamanager SundK" in the 2024 report [^src2], reflecting changes in organizational structure or administrative designation over the reporting cycle. His role in data management places him within the technical infrastructure supporting DANIBD's coverage of 33,381 IBD patients treated across Denmark's five regions during the 2022–2023 period [^src1].
